items.title: Human: Event Planning
items.description:
• Weeks of searching venues, caterers, and RSVPs.
• Overlooked details, budget creep, and high stress.
• Personal touch, emotional connection, real-time adapting.

items.title: AI: Event Planning
items.description:
• Generates themes, guest lists, and budget ideas fast.
• Provides quick initial drafts and vendor suggestions.
• Lacks intuition, can't handle last-minute human changes.

items.description:

• Critical thinking, ethical judgment, patient empathy.

items.title: AI: Medical Research
items.description:
• Summarizes complex papers and finds relevant studies fast.
• Efficiently cross-references data, identifies trends.
• Risks hallucination, no clinical judgment, data cutoff.

items.title: Human: Data Analysis
items.description:

items.title: AI: Data Analysis
items.description:
• Analyzes vast datasets in seconds, finds patterns.
• Automates report generation and trend identification.
• Can't interpret nuanced context or question data quality.

items.description:

items.description:

items.description:
